title: Excess and game optimum
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q>0$ labels, and suppose the label set is nonempty. Let a tester family satisfy the dictator-versus-no-notables conditions with parameters $\alpha$ and $\beta$ and error function $\operatorname{error}$. If $T$ is a table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$, $0<\epsilon\le1$, and the tester’s averaged acceptance value on $T$ is at least $\alpha+\operatorname{error}(\epsilon)+\tau$, then $\tau\epsilon^5/18$ is at most the optimum value of the constraint satisfaction instance associated to $G$.
hypotheses_covered: Tester family satisfies all dictator-versus-no-notables conditions
A bounded table of cube functions
Tester averaged acceptance is at least $\alpha+\operatorname{error}(\epsilon)+\tau$
caveat: The tester condition is a bundled structure with several fields; the statement summarizes it rather than spelling out every field.
